<thought>The base peak at m/z 114.06808 in positive‑mode ESI likely corresponds to the [M+H]⁺ ion. Subtracting the mass of a proton (1.007276 Da) gives a neutral mass of ≈113.0608 Da. A formula that matches this exact mass and the observed ~6.7 % M+1 isotope intensity (consistent with ~6 % from six carbons) is C₆H₉O₂ (exact monoisotopic mass 113.060255 Da). The calculated [M+H]⁺ mass (114.067531 Da) is within 0.5 mDa of the measured value, confirming the assignment.</thought>
<final_answer>C6H9O2</final_answer>
